name: io.github.pain2hustle/cloudflare-ops-mcp
title: AMH Cloudflare Ops MCP by WT
description: Approval-gated Cloudflare ops for agents: DNS, email auth, Pages, cache, Turnstile, tokens.

tools.name: scan_zone
tools.description: Read-only snapshot of a domain's Cloudflare zone: all DNS records plus parsed SPF, DMARC, BIMI, and Email Routing status. Never writes.

tools.name: plan_email_auth
tools.description: Analyze a domain's email authentication (SPF/DKIM/DMARC/BIMI/routing) and report what is missing or misconfigured, with the exact records to add. Never writes.

inbox.description: Where DMARC aggregate reports should go, e.g. you@gmail.com

tools.name: verify_domain
tools.description: Re-scan a domain and return a pass/fail checklist: SPF, DMARC present + enforced, MX, Email Routing, BIMI, DKIM count. Never writes.

domain.description: Domain or zone name, for example example.com.

tools.name: apply_dns_record
tools.description: Upsert a single DNS record (create if absent, update if content differs, no-op if identical). DRY-RUN by default — returns the planned diff and writes nothing unless apply=true. Never deletes.

domain.description: Domain or zone name, for example example.com.

proxied.description: Proxy the record through Cloudflare (orange cloud).

apply.description: Set true to actually write. Default false = dry-run.

tools.name: delete_dns_record
tools.description: Delete exactly one DNS record after a fresh lookup. Requires domain, exact record_id, matching expected_name, and confirm=true. Refuses by default and never deletes by name alone.

record_id.description: Exact DNS record id returned by scan_zone

expected_name.description: Exact hostname expected for that record id

confirm.description: Must be true to perform the deletion

tools.name: set_dmarc_policy
tools.description: Change the _dmarc policy (none|quarantine|reject), preserving other tags. DRY-RUN by default — returns the before/after diff and writes nothing unless apply=true.

domain.description: Domain or zone name, for example example.com.

policy.description: DMARC policy: none (monitor), quarantine or reject.

tools.name: setup_bimi
tools.description: Create/update the default._bimi TXT record pointing at a logo SVG. REFUSES to write when DMARC is p=none (unless force=true) because BIMI won't be honored without enforced DMARC. DRY-RUN by default.

domain.description: Domain or zone name, for example example.com.

logo.description: HTTPS URL to an SVG Tiny-PS logo

vmc.description: Optional Verified Mark Certificate PEM URL

tools.name: setup_email_routing
tools.description: Enable Cloudflare Email Routing and create forward rules (+ optional catch-all). Cloudflare auto-adds the MX/SPF records. DRY-RUN by default. Destination addresses must be verified by their owner via Cloudflare's email.

domain.description: Domain or zone name, for example example.com.

forwards.description: Rules: { address, to } forwards to an email address, or { address, worker } routes to a Cloudflare Email Worker (no destination verification needed). e.g. { address: 'hello@example.com', to: 'you@gmail.com' } or { address: 'bot@example.com', worker: 'my-email-worker' }

force.description: Create rules even to unverified destinations (not recommended — they stay disabled).

tools.name: pages_cutover
tools.description: Plan or apply a Cloudflare Pages DNS cutover. Deletes only conflicting apex/www A/AAAA/CNAME records and www NS delegations, then creates proxied CNAMEs to the Pages target. DRY-RUN by default; writes only when apply=true.

include_www.description: Also cut over www. Default true.

include_wildcard.description: Also remove conflicting wildcard records. Default false.

tools.name: purge_cache
tools.description: Purge Cloudflare's cache for a zone — the whole zone (default) or specific URLs. DRY-RUN by default: returns the scope and purges NOTHING unless apply=true. Needs a token with Zone > Cache Purge.

everything.description: Purge the whole zone cache (default when no urls given).

tools.name: create_turnstile_widget
tools.description: Plan or create a Cloudflare Turnstile widget for a domain. DRY-RUN by default; creates the widget only when apply=true. Returns the public sitekey and one-time secret when applied.

extra_domains.description: Additional hostnames allowed to use this widget.

tools.name: mint_scoped_token
tools.description: Mint a narrow, auto-expiring Cloudflare API token for ONE zone (presets: zone-read, dns-zone, cache-purge; default 1h TTL). The vending machine for least-privilege agent work: hand a cheap agent a key that can't hurt anything and dies on its own. DRY-RUN by default — returns the exact policy JSON; mints nothing unless apply=true. Needs a bootstrap token with 'API Tokens Write'. There is deliberately NO super/account-wide preset.

domain.description: Zone the token is confined to, e.g. example.com

ttl_seconds.description: Lifetime in seconds. Default 3600; capped at 86400 unless confirm_long=true.

confirm_long.description: Required to exceed the 24h TTL cap.

name.description: Optional token label for the CF dashboard.

keep_days.description: How many days this token may sit unused before the auditor revokes it (1-365). Default = token_audit_settings unused_days.

tools.name: list_tokens
tools.description: List API tokens on the connected user: id, name, status, expiry, and whether cfops minted them. NEVER returns token values (Cloudflare only shows those once, at mint). Read-only.

tools.name: revoke_token
tools.description: Revoke an API token by id (e.g. a minted task-token you're done with early). DRY-RUN by default; deletes nothing unless apply=true.

tools.name: who_serves_domain
tools.description: Answer 'what is ACTUALLY serving this domain?': zone → Worker routes, Worker custom domains, and Pages projects that claim it, with a warning when multiple products fight over it. Read-only.

tools.name: account_doctor
tools.description: Diagnose the token/account situation: accounts visible to this token, whether the expected account is among them (wrong-token detection), and SAME-NAME Pages projects across accounts — the decoy that silently eats deploys. Read-only.

expected_account_id.description: Account id deploys are SUPPOSED to target.

tools.name: pages_branch_check
tools.description: Compare a Pages project's production branch against the branch you're about to deploy — catches the silent 'git says master, project says main, every deploy lands on a preview' failure. Read-only.

account_id.description: Account that owns the Pages project.

git_branch.description: Branch you intend to deploy; enables the match/mismatch verdict.

tools.name: walo_diagnostic_repair
tools.description: Owner-only fixed diagnostic repair for walo-mcp and localops-whatsapp-bridge in Austin Doors. Inspect returns source/config hashes and rollback version without values or source. Stage uploads only embedded reviewed edits; deploy requires staged verification. Status and guarded rollback are limited to this one-time repair. Also permits the separately approved fixed tenant-1 sender-cache inspection/correction and fixed owner-only read-only notification probe installation. Includes the fixed seven-day tenant-1-owner session-receipt revision and bounded read of its sanitized records. No arbitrary source, generic execution, new credentials, database routes or messages.

action.description: Which step to run; see the allowed values. Inspect/status steps are read-only.

expected_snapshot_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the snapshot you inspected; the call refuses if live has changed since.

candidate_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the staged candidate; must match before verify/deploy.

confirm.description: Must be true to run a step that changes anything.

_approved.description: Set true only after the owner approved this exact change. Without it the tool refuses or stays read-only.

tools.name: apiary_cache_repair
tools.description: Owner-only, one-time fixed Apiary HEAD/empty-cache repair. snapshot returns a private gzip backup; stage uploads the embedded reviewed patch without deploying; deploy requires verified local-preview source hash; status/rollback are limited to this operation. No arbitrary code, account, resource, cache deletion or credential changes.

action.description: Which step to run; see the allowed values. Inspect/status steps are read-only.

expected_snapshot_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the snapshot you inspected; the call refuses if live has changed since.

backup_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the backup taken by the snapshot step; must match before restore.

local_preview_source_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the locally previewed source; must match the staged copy.

confirm.description: Must be true to run a step that changes anything.

_approved.description: Set true only after the owner approved this exact change. Without it the tool refuses or stays read-only.

tools.name: apiary_worker_deployments
tools.description: Read active deployment and recent deployment history for apiary-bee on Austin Doors. First item serves traffic. Past versions are rollback candidates, not validated rollbacks.

_approved.description: Set true only after the owner approved this exact change. Without it the tool refuses or stays read-only.

tools.name: apiary_worker_version
tools.description: Read only version identity, script etag, runtime compatibility and binding names/types for one apiary-bee version. Never returns values, source code or secrets.

_approved.description: Set true only after the owner approved this exact change. Without it the tool refuses or stays read-only.

tools.name: apiary_r2_objects_list
tools.description: One metadata-only page from apiary-reading-html, fixed community/reading/ prefix. Follow every next_cursor until page_exhausted; this call never proves the entire inventory complete.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor returned by the previous call.

_approved.description: Set true only after the owner approved this exact change. Without it the tool refuses or stays read-only.

tools.name: pages_deploy
tools.description: Deploy a COMPLETE built static site to a Cloudflare Pages project through the API (like `wrangler pages deploy`, no PC needed). Dry-run by default; apply=true uploads and deploys. branch = production branch goes LIVE; any other branch is a preview URL. A deploy replaces the whole site, so send every file. To change only a few files on a live site use pages_patch (or pass patch=true with edits [{path,find,replace}] here). Static only (no functions/). artificialmindhive production is refused.

account.description: amh (pain2hustle1), doors (austinsdoors1), artificialmindhive, servicepricer (souljaboy.app), kodak (kodakblack.app), or an account id

files.description: Files to write: [{path, content}] (content as text or base64).

commit_hash.description: Git commit hash recorded on the Pages deployment.

apply.description: false (default) returns a dry-run diff only; true makes the change.

tools.name: pages_list_deployments
tools.description: List recent deployments of a Pages project, marking the one serving production. Read-only.

account.description: Cloudflare account alias to act on (for example amh, doors, servicepricer, kodak). Defaults to the hub's main account.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

tools.name: pages_get_deployment
tools.description: Details of one Pages deployment: url, branch, stages, commit message. Pass path (+ optional find) to read that file's RAW live text instead. Read-only.

account.description: Cloudflare account alias to act on (for example amh, doors, servicepricer, kodak). Defaults to the hub's main account.

tools.name: pages_rollback
tools.description: Put a past production deployment back live. Dry-run by default; apply=true rolls back. artificialmindhive needs force=true plus a note.

account.description: Cloudflare account alias to act on (for example amh, doors, servicepricer, kodak). Defaults to the hub's main account.

apply.description: false (default) returns a dry-run diff only; true makes the change.

force.description: Skip the safety check that would otherwise refuse this call. Use with care.

note.description: Free-text note saved with the rollback in the audit log.

tools.name: wrangler_doctor
tools.description: One-call health check: Pages projects (with production branch + domains) and Workers on both accounts, plus live vs latest deployment for one project. Read-only.

account.description: Cloudflare account alias to act on (for example amh, doors, servicepricer, kodak). Defaults to the hub's main account.

tools.name: pages_read_file
tools.description: Read the RAW text of one file exactly as the live production deployment serves it (no summarizer, no proxy). Use find to get the exact snippet(s) around a string; else returns content in chunks (offset/length). Read-only.

account.description: Cloudflare account alias to act on (for example amh, doors, servicepricer, kodak). Defaults to the hub's main account.

find.description: Text to search for; returns the matching excerpt instead of the whole file.

offset.description: Start position (characters or lines) for paging through a file.

length.description: Maximum number of characters or lines to return.

tools.name: pages_patch
tools.description: Change ONLY a few files on a live Pages site (no PC, no full file set). Best: edits [{path, find, replace}] — the hub fetches the live file, replaces the exact text (must match once), and deploys. Or files [{path, content}] for whole changed files. The hub copies the live deployment's file list, swaps in the changes (and removes any in delete), keeps _redirects/_headers, and deploys. Every other file stays exactly as live. Dry-run by default; apply=true deploys. branch = production branch goes LIVE, any other = preview. Returns rollback_hint. Sites with server code (artificialmindhive) re-attach the owner-saved worker bundle and get a title + API health check after deploy, with automatic rollback on failure.

account.description: amh (pain2hustle1), doors (austinsdoors1), artificialmindhive, servicepricer (souljaboy.app), or kodak (kodakblack.app)

delete.description: paths to remove from the site

apply.description: false (default) returns a dry-run diff only; true makes the change.

tools.name: pages_special_files
tools.description: Read (no args besides account/project) or save the hub's copy of a project's _redirects/_headers, which pages_patch re-sends on every patch.

account.description: Cloudflare account alias to act on (for example amh, doors, servicepricer, kodak). Defaults to the hub's main account.

_redirects.description: Full new contents of the Pages _redirects file.

_headers.description: Full new contents of the Pages _headers file.

tools.name: repo_list
tools.description: List Austin's GitHub repos (pain2hustle/* and pain2hustle1/*): default branch, last push, private flag. Optional q filters by name/description. No PC needed.

tools.name: repo_read
tools.description: Read a file (raw text) or list a folder from a pain2hustle repo at a branch/ref. Use find (+around) to get exact snippets, or offset/length for big files. No PC needed.

path.description: File path inside the repository or site.

ref.description: Git branch, tag or commit to read from. Defaults to the default branch.

find.description: Text to search for; returns the matching excerpt instead of the whole file.

around.description: Line number to centre the returned excerpt on.

offset.description: Start position (characters or lines) for paging through a file.

length.description: Maximum number of characters or lines to return.

tools.name: repo_search
tools.description: Search code inside one pain2hustle repo (GitHub code search). Returns matching file paths.

tools.name: repo_commit_push
tools.description: Commit to a grok/<name> (or agent/<name>) branch on GitHub in ONE commit, no PC. Branch is created from the default branch if new. files [{path, content, encoding?:'base64', delete?:true}] and/or edits [{path, find, replace}] applied to the branch's current file. Never touches the default branch, never force-pushes, never writes .github/.

files.description: Files to write: [{path, content}] (content as text or base64).

edits.description: List of {path, old, new} text replacements to apply.

author.description: Commit author shown in git history (name, not a credential).

tools.name: repo_open_pr
tools.description: Open (or find) a pull request from a grok/<name> branch into the default branch so Austin can review and merge.

tools.name: repo_merge_pr
tools.description: Merge an open grok/* or agent/* pull request into the default branch (normal merge commit, history kept, no force). Refused if the PR touches .github/.

tools.name: site_views
tools.description: READ-ONLY traffic for one of Austin's domains from Cloudflare analytics: requests, page views and unique visitors for today, the last 7 days or the last 30 days, plus the period before it to compare, and a per-day list. Counts include bots unless noted. Use it for 'how many views on X'.

tools.name: pages_create_project
tools.description: Create a NEW Cloudflare Pages project (empty site at <name>.pages.dev). Dry-run unless apply=true. Then use pages_deploy to put files on it and pages_add_domain for a custom domain.

account.description: amh (pain2hustle1), doors (austinsdoors1), artificialmindhive, servicepricer (souljaboy.app), or kodak (kodakblack.app)

apply.description: false (default) returns a dry-run diff only; true makes the change.

tools.name: pages_add_domain
tools.description: Attach a custom domain (e.g. tacos.com or www.tacos.com) to a Pages project, or show the status of its domains. If the domain's zone is on the same Cloudflare account, Cloudflare sets up DNS itself; otherwise the result says what record to add. Dry-run unless apply=true.

account.description: amh (pain2hustle1), doors (austinsdoors1), artificialmindhive, servicepricer (souljaboy.app), or kodak (kodakblack.app)

domain.description: omit to just list the project's domains

apply.description: false (default) returns a dry-run diff only; true makes the change.

tools.name: worker_deploy
tools.description: Deploy a small Cloudflare Worker (one ES-module file, export default { fetch }) next to a site, e.g. an AI chat endpoint or a form handler. Optional bindings: ai=true gives env.AI (Workers AI, e.g. env.AI.run('@cf/moonshotai/kimi-k2.6', {messages})), d1=[{binding, database_id}] gives env.<binding>, vars={NAME:'value'}. Publishes at <name>.<account>.workers.dev. Refuses to overwrite any Worker the hub didn't create (Austin's existing workers are safe). Dry-run unless apply=true. Remember the account's free AI allowance is shared: add a rate limit to anything public.

account.description: amh (pain2hustle1), doors (austinsdoors1), artificialmindhive, servicepricer (souljaboy.app), or kodak (kodakblack.app)

name.description: Name of the Worker or database to create.

ai.description: Bind Workers AI to the Worker as env.AI.

vars.description: Plain-text environment variables to set on the Worker.

apply.description: false (default) returns a dry-run diff only; true makes the change.

tools.name: d1_create
tools.description: Create a new D1 database (or list existing ones when name is omitted). Dry-run unless apply=true.

account.description: amh (pain2hustle1), doors (austinsdoors1), artificialmindhive, servicepricer (souljaboy.app), or kodak (kodakblack.app)

name.description: Name of the Worker or database to create.

apply.description: false (default) returns a dry-run diff only; true makes the change.

tools.name: d1_query
tools.description: READ-ONLY SQL on a D1 database (SELECT / WITH / PRAGMA / EXPLAIN only). database = name or id. Returns rows.

account.description: amh (pain2hustle1), doors (austinsdoors1), artificialmindhive, servicepricer (souljaboy.app), or kodak (kodakblack.app)

params.description: Positional bind values for ? placeholders in the SQL.

tools.name: d1_exec
tools.description: WRITE SQL on a D1 database (CREATE TABLE, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE...). Dry-run unless apply=true; Austin must approve writes. DROP of a table needs force=true.

account.description: amh (pain2hustle1), doors (austinsdoors1), artificialmindhive, servicepricer (souljaboy.app), or kodak (kodakblack.app)

params.description: Positional bind values for ? placeholders in the SQL.

apply.description: false (default) returns a dry-run diff only; true makes the change.

force.description: Skip the safety check that would otherwise refuse this call. Use with care.

tools.name: my_tasks
tools.description: Check your inbox: open tasks for you (or for 'any'). Run this when Austin says 'check your inbox'. Then claim_task → do the work → finish_task.

agent.description: your name: grok, claude, jubber, codex

tools.name: post_task
tools.description: Give a task to another agent (or yourself later) on the shared AMH agent board. to: grok | claude | jubber | codex | owner (Austin) | any.

text.description: Task text for the receiving agent.

notify.description: WhatsApp-ping Austin when it's finished (default true)

tools.name: claim_task
tools.description: Claim an inbox task before working on it, so no other agent does it twice.

agent.description: Name of the agent claiming or finishing the task.

tools.name: finish_task
tools.description: Mark an inbox task done (or failed=true) with a short result: what you did, links, deployment ids. Pings Austin on WhatsApp if the task asked for it.

agent.description: Name of the agent claiming or finishing the task.

result.description: What was done, for the task record.

failed.description: true if the task could not be completed.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: The whole agent board: every task, optionally by status (open/claimed/done/failed) or by who it's for.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

tools.name: cancel_task
tools.description: Cancel an open or claimed task.

reason.description: Why the task is being cancelled.

tools.name: worker_patch_grant
tools.description: Step 1 of landing server code on an allow-listed Worker (amh-site-revival-proxy, wp-test): get a single-use grant for this exact patch (expires in 10 min). Same script/edits/request_id go to worker_patch.

edits.description: List of {path, old, new} text replacements to apply.

tools.name: worker_patch
tools.description: Step 2: land the patch. dry_run:true shows what would change and uses nothing. Live code must equal the latest version and the repo file, or it refuses. Checks the new version on its preview URL, goes live, checks live, rolls back by itself on failure, syncs the repo. Same request_id again returns the first receipt.

request_id.description: Patch request id returned by an earlier call.

edits.description: List of {path, old, new} text replacements to apply.

base_version.description: optional: the live version you read; refuses if it changed

dry_run.description: true returns what would change without applying it.

tools.name: worker_patch_sync
tools.description: Owner: put the repo's main file for an allow-listed Worker live exactly as written (preview check, live check, rollback). Needed once, or after someone deployed another way. dry_run defaults to true.

dry_run.description: true returns what would change without applying it.

tools.name: worker_patch_status
tools.description: Receipt for a worker_patch request id (state, versions, checks, rollback, repo commit).

request_id.description: Patch request id returned by an earlier call.

tools.name: site_gate_pass
tools.description: Owner/agent: get past a password-gated site (souljaboy). Returns the gate code to type in a browser and a Cookie header for fetches. With path, fetches that page behind the gate and returns status, title and text.

site.description: Site to issue a gate pass for.

tools.name: soulja_artist_access
tools.description: Owner/agent, read-only: receipt for souljaboy.app artist sites. Rule: <name>.souljaboy.app -> Pages project <name>-souljaboy (one label; not apex or reserved: www, e40, 40water, artist, thizzler, atmosphere, stones-throw, hieroglyphics, sari, site1, mail, api, mcp, admin; never a name bound to another project or with a different DNS record). Confirms the account that owns the zone, the hub credential's Pages/DNS permissions, the mapping and state (project, binding, DNS) of the first five artists plus any hostname you pass, and the exact deploy calls. Changes nothing.

hostname.description: optional extra hostname to check, e.g. mozzy.souljaboy.app

tools.name: email_austin
tools.description: Email Austin a result: a short note, a link (preview URL, PR, file), or a report. Plain text; keep it short and put links on their own lines. Use it when Austin says 'email me', or to deliver something that does not fit WhatsApp. Owner/agent keys only.

link.description: optional URL put on its own line at the end

from_agent.description: your name, e.g. grok, codex, claude, jubber

html.description: optional HTML body (text is still required)

tools.name: token_audit_settings
tools.description: Read or change the token auditor: unused_days = how long a hub-minted (cfops) token may sit unused before it is revoked (default 7). Admin keys can change it.

tools.name: agent_research_start
tools.description: Delegate a bounded research, verification, zero-AI site-health, UI, Cloudflare diagnosis, inventory, data review, missed-items, or revision-proposal job to the private AMH WT coordinator. Returns immediately with job and memory hashes; the configured free lane or explicitly enabled paid K2 lane runs durably in the background.

agent_name.description: Friendly reusable name shown in the console, terminal, logs, and handoffs.

objective.description: Exact bounded task and evidence required.

allowed_domains.description: Explicit domains the crawler may access.

urls.description: HTTPS seed URLs inside the allowlist.

context.description: Only compact relevant context; never secrets.

expected_text.description: Optional short marker required by the zero-AI site-health check to catch a 200 response serving the wrong page.

schedule.description: Optional repeat schedule for the job, for example {every_minutes}.

tools.name: agent_research_status
tools.description: Read one delegated job, including its redacted timeline, sources, primary result, independent verifier result, gaps, and candidate revisions.

job_id.description: Research job id returned by agent_research_start.

tools.name: agent_research_list
tools.description: List recent delegated jobs for this authenticated user. Read-only and tenant-isolated.

tools.name: agent_briefing
tools.description: Return the Continuity Keeper's current compact project briefing and memory hash: active platform, target, blocker, keep/archive/drop guidance, and next safe step.

tools.name: agent_control
tools.description: Safely pause or resume new agent work, cancel a queued/running job at its next phase boundary, force read-only mode, or run retention cleanup. Models cannot disable read-only mode.

action.description: Which step to run; see the allowed values. Inspect/status steps are read-only.
